findings.title: Watchability ranker — surface tonight's best games
evidence: watchability-engine.js — pure scoring module (form/quality/stakes/streak + division bonus)
app.js renderUpcoming/renderGameRow — top-3 badges, reasons, lead-ordering
verified in-browser via mocked fetch: 3 of 4 games badged, marquee leads

history.note: Baseline. Strategic Fit 7/10. Deterministic ranking over already-fetched data; no backend/LLM needed. Highest-feasibility recommendation.
Phase 1 (v1.2.0): built + unit-tested + browser-verified. Deterministic, no backend, no new fetches. Shipped to working tree; pending deploy.

findings.title: AI Daily Briefing — plain-language league summary (template first, LLM optional)
evidence: verified in-browser via mocked fetch: 5 grounded highlights rendered, all traceable to real numbers

history.note: Baseline. Strategic Fit 7/10. Template version ships with no backend; LLM upgrade gated on serverless key-proxy (see GAP-001).

Phase 2 (v1.3.0): template version built + unit-tested + browser-verified. Deterministic, no backend, no new fetches, no fabricated stats. LLM phrasing upgrade remains a future Phase-4 option gated on GAP-001.

findings.title: Plain-language chart explainers on Trends widgets
evidence: trends-explainers.js — pure caption helpers for 4 charts (RSRA, OPS/ERA, home/road, power/discipline)
trends-charts.js setExplainer() injects captions into each card, refreshed on filter change
verified in-browser via stubbed Chart.js: all 4 captions render with correct leaders + styling

history.note: Baseline. Strategic Fit 5/10. Cheap polish; template fill, no dependency. Lower ceiling because static descriptions already orient users.
Phase 3 (v1.4.0): built + unit-tested + browser-verified. Deterministic captions over already-merged Trends data; no backend, no new fetches; updates with filters.

findings.title: No backend / serverless function — blocks any keyed AI or 3rd-party API call
evidence: no server code in repo; GitHub Pages hosting

history.note: Baseline. Hard prerequisite for the LLM path of OPP-002 and for OPP-004. A static site cannot safely hold a model key. Not a bug — a boundary condition.

findings.title: No data persistence / historical accumulation — no day-over-day memory

history.note: Baseline. Removes the basis for predictive AI (no owned training data) and multi-season browsing.

findings.title: No telemetry / analytics — zero signal on what users view
evidence: no analytics/tracking calls anywhere in repo

history.note: Baseline. Prerequisite for personalization/recommendations and for evidence-based prioritization of OPP-004 (Q&A).

findings.title: No automated tests for pure compute engines
evidence: tests/rankings-engine.test.js, tests/trends-engine.test.js, tests/watchability-engine.test.js — 23 cases passing via node:test
package.json adds type:module + test script; no runtime deps added

history.note: Baseline. Low-cost, high-confidence win: the two pure engines are trivially unit-testable and underpin every view.
Phase 0: node:test harness stood up; both existing pure engines (rankings, trends) now unit-tested, 15 cases green.
Phase 1: watchability engine added with 8 tests; all current pure compute engines now covered (23 cases). New engines should ship with tests per this established practice.

findings.title: Hard dependency on unauthenticated public MLB Stats API (single point of failure)
evidence: no caching across loads; every visit re-hits the API

history.note: Baseline. If MLB changes/rate-limits/retires the undocumented public endpoints, the whole app goes dark. Mitigated only by a graceful error banner (app.js:429), not by resilience. Off-season also yields sparse/empty data.

findings.title: Predictive/odds AI would be a trust-eroding gimmick without owned data
evidence: Layer 3 category sweep — Predictive AI cut

history.note: Baseline. Logged as a guardrail: resist adding 'win probability' numbers that look authoritative but aren't backed by a real model. A wrong number on a stats product discredits the whole site.

findings.title: Clean layered architecture with documented inter-module contracts

history.note: Baseline. The product's strongest durable asset: separation of data/compute/view makes every recommended feature cheap to add. Drives the +30 cleanliness credit in AI Readiness.

findings.title: Resilient UX: typed errors, loading/empty/retry states, 30-team integrity guarantee

history.note: Baseline. Production-grade resilience uncommon at this scale; renders 30 teams even on partial API responses.
